name: Kasumigaseki
tagline: Toranomon in 1 minute and Tokyo in 5 minutes. Served by 3 lines.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, served by Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 5 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 20 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 7.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 7.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.4 m to 20.7 m, a difference of 16.3 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 18 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 浩邦会日比谷病院, about 715 m away and 虎の門病院, about 776 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line. All 3 lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 68.

neighbours.lead: Sakuradamon is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 400 m away in a straight line. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kasumigaseki.

neighbours.lead: Kokkai-Gijidomae is ahead on how easy the shopping is and quiet, but Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: 513 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kasumigaseki.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: OpenStreetMap records no supermarket within walking distance of the station.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
